data.description: Elite Comforts | Perfect Location | Spectacular Views
data.display_address: Park Lane, Dubai Hills Estate, Dubai
data.long_description:
Park Lane by Emaar is a distinguished residential development situated in the heart of the vibrant Dubai Hills neighborhood. Renowned for its modern architectural elegance, Park Lane seamlessly integrates with the tranquil surroundings of Dubai Hills Estate. Each structure within the project marries aesthetics with functionality, showcasing both artistic refinement and innovative design.

Living Spaces:

  Park Lane offers a range of refined living options, including:

3-bedroom townhouses
1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments

  These residences are crafted to meet diverse lifestyle needs, providing a blend of style and comfort.

Features and Amenities:
Elegant Design: Overlooks a beautifully landscaped podium and offers views of meticulously designed outdoor areas.
On-Site Amenities: Includes equipped gyms, swimming pools, children's play areas, and a barbecue area.
Proximity to Key Locations: Directly opposite Dubai Hills Park with wadi paths, a children's play area, sports facilities, and a gym. Close to Dubai Hills Mall and Dubai Hills Golf Club. Convenient access to Downtown Dubai (12 minutes), Dubai Marina (15 minutes), and Dubai International Airport (20 minutes).
Financial Assistance:

  Finance options are available through Premier Property Finance. For a free consultation, call us at +97143233609.
